properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland. The property comprises; two receptions, fitted 18'9 x 10'1 kitchen/breakfast room and conservatory. The property also benefits from having a utility room and cloakroom. To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate WC. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating and a well presented interior.
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description: Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat. The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms. This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee.

Stunning four bedroom detached Victorian home with period features throughout. This beautiful property offers spacious accommodation including entrance hall, two reception rooms, extended kitchen/dining room, utility room, and ground floor WC. The first floor comprises four generous bedrooms and a luxury family bathroom. The property benefits from a large rear garden, off-street parking for multiple vehicles, and a detached garage. Located in a highly sought-after residential area close to excellent schools and transport links.

Modern one bedroom apartment perfect for first-time buyers or investors. This contemporary flat features an open-plan living area with fully integrated kitchen, spacious bedroom with built-in wardrobes, and a modern bathroom suite. The property includes allocated parking, communal gardens, and is within walking distance to the town centre and station. The development offers secure entry and is maintained to a high standard throughout.

Exceptional five bedroom executive detached home set in approximately 0.3 acres. This impressive property features a grand entrance hall, three reception rooms, bespoke fitted kitchen/breakfast room with integrated appliances, separate utility room, and guest cloakroom. The first floor offers five double bedrooms with the master suite benefiting from en-suite facilities and dressing area. Additional features include landscaped gardens, double garage, driveway parking for several vehicles, and underfloor heating throughout the ground floor.

Spacious three bedroom top floor apartment with stunning views. This well-presented flat comprises a bright living room with feature fireplace, modern fitted kitchen, three good-sized bedrooms, family bathroom, and separate WC. The property benefits from double glazing, gas central heating, allocated parking, and communal gardens. Conveniently located close to local amenities, schools, and transport links with direct trains to Central London.
properties.location: West Wickham Road, West Wickham BR4

properties.description: Charming two bedroom terraced cottage in a prime location. This delightful property features a cozy living room with wood burner, dining room, newly fitted kitchen, and conservatory overlooking the rear garden. Upstairs are two double bedrooms and a contemporary bathroom. The property has been tastefully modernized while retaining many original character features including exposed beams and wooden floors. The south-facing garden is perfect for entertaining with a paved patio area and lawn.
